اقترحا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَرَحَا (iqtaraḥā) /iq.ta.ra.ħaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# اُقْتُرِحَا (uqturiḥā) /uq.tu.ri.ħaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
# اِقْتَرِحَا (iqtariḥā) /iq.ta.ri.ħaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِقْتَرَحَ (iqtaraḥa)
